learning: Iteration 0 is a baseline. The first race will show whether H1 (clean monotonic edge signal), H2 (0.06 m off-track limit is the binding failure) and H3 (mass and track give enough authority without slip at base_speed about 2) hold. Carry the result into the next controller and geometry as revised hypotheses.
notes: Baseline complete robot: symmetric five-sensor array at 10 mm pitch with 12 mm footprint, normalised sideways weights, kp 2.5, kd 0.1, no integral, base_speed 1.8, last-direction line recovery. Derived from the contract only, since iteration 0 has no telemetry.
rationale: Iteration 0 has no race telemetry, so the controller is derived from the contract alone. The five sensors sit at x = -0.02 to +0.02 m (positive = left) and y = 0.06 m. Setting sensor_weights equal to the normalised sideways position, [-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1], makes the steering signal a direct, bounded estimate of the line's lateral offset in the range roughly +/-1 (the 10 mm pitch and 12 mm footprint give a monotonic reading as the tape moves across the array). A positive signal steers left, which matches the sensor sign convention. kp = 2.5 gives a turn of about 2.5 for a full-scale signal, which is a 875-count wheel difference. That is enough to correct a moderate offset without saturating for small errors. ki = 0 avoids integral windup on a curved course with no steady bias to remove. kd = 0.1 adds a small damping term; the lookahead at y = 0.06 m already adds phase lead, so a large kd would amplify sensor noise and could cause jitter. base_speed = 1.8 is chosen to meet the roughly 1.5 m/s average needed to finish in 3 s with some headroom for the slower bends, and it stays below 2 so the robot is not at the voltage limit. line_loss = 'last_direction' keeps the robot turning toward the side it last saw the tape, which is the more reliable recovery on smooth bends than a fixed search direction. Expected result: a completable run with smooth steering. The main unknowns are whether the speed is too high for the sharpest bend and whether kd is adequate given the lookahead lag. The observation request covers all metrics so the next race can test H1 to H3 directly.
